title: Microsoft Intune: granular RBAC permissions for endpoint security workloads
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap's planned permissions from Microsoft's partially completed implementation. Its paths, Graph calls and licensing qualifications are supported; minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting administrator-licensing guidance and remove a report-access checklist step not represented in the controls table.
